title: Outright Purchase of an In-Home PAP Therapy Equipment Unit
content:
# Outright Purchase of an In-Home PAP Therapy Equipment Unit

A patient may buy outright the PAP Therapy Equipment unit that already stands in their home on a coverage-billed device record, as a self-pay purchase, instead of returning it.

**When the price is fixed.** The price of a unit bought where it already stands in the patient's home is fixed only after the device record carries a usage summary crediting the qualifying nights. As long as the device record carries no usage summary crediting the qualifying nights, the price of that unit is not yet fixed.

**Effect of the sale.** The sale ends the coverage rental: the self-pay sale line is the patient's record of owning the unit, the device record keeps its status and coverage as they stand, and a rental month is billed only while the device record is on trial or in active rental and carries no self-pay sale of the unit.

## How the sale is booked

The sale is booked with `purchase_home_device_8c1f8216`, a tool the customer themselves runs: the agent unlocks it and hands it over to the customer, and the customer themselves runs it, paying the price in full. One run books one self-pay sale line on the device record, dated today. No delivery fee is charged because the unit is already in the home.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `pap_holding_id` | the PAP device record number of the unit being bought, as shown by the PAP device record lookup for the patient | record number as shown |
| `hcpcs_code` | the device code of the unit bought | exactly one of: `E0601` when the record's device class is a CPAP class (its class name ends in E0601); `E0470` when the class is the Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System; `E0471` when the class is the Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System or the Adaptive Servo-Ventilation System |
| `sale_amount` | the sale amount charged to the patient for the unit | USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

### Return

On success the tool returns, as text, a dictionary with `status` ("sold" when the sale line was booked), `pap_bill_id` (reference number of the sale line), `pap_holding_id` (the device record), `service_from_date` (the delivery date booked on the sale line, which for a unit already in the home is the day of the sale, YYYY-MM-DD), `hcpcs_code` (the device code) and `sale_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places). The sale line appears in the device's billing history and the patient can quote its reference number.

## Desk questions

**Does the device record change status on the sale?** No. It keeps its status and coverage as they stand; the self-pay sale line is the patient's record of owning the unit.

**Is the unit's rental still billed afterwards?** A rental month is billed only while the record is on trial or in active rental and carries no self-pay sale of the unit.
